home.text: Skip to content Keep your network running. Turn surplus equipment into value. Carritech provides technical support, equipment supply and repair for telecom networks — and recovers, redeploys and responsibly recycles equipment when it is no longer required. Explore Our Services → Talk to Carritech 200k+ parts in stock 16+ years supporting networks since 2010 100+ countries served worldwide 1,000+ tonnes of e-waste recycled What we do We keep telecom equipment working, and recover its value when it's retired. Every service can be used independently and in any combination — from supporting equipment while your network needs it, to recovering its value when it no longer does. While your network needs it Keep your network running L3 Technical Support Learn more → Equipment Supply Learn more → Hardware Repair Learn more → Optical Solutions Learn more → When it no longer does Turn surplus equipment into value Asset Management Learn more → Equipment Purchase Learn more → Deinstallation Learn more → Reuse & Redeployment Learn more → USE MAINTAIN RECOVER REDEPLOY // the circular lifecycle Equipment one operator retires is the spare part another still needs. Telecom equipment moves through a lifecycle: it is used, maintained and extended while an operator needs it, then recovered and redeployed when they don’t. Carritech works on both sides of that journey — so hardware keeps earning its keep instead of being scrapped. ↻ Responsible recycling is the route for equipment that genuinely cannot be reused — not the final stage of every journey. Reuse always comes first. Equipment & technologies Find the equipment already in your network. Search more than 200,000 tested parts by part number, manufacturer or platform — then route straight to supply, repair or support for that equipment.
